title: Profile-driven math delimiting (S1-R1)
question: Can math delimiting be generated from the source profile without changing any result?
method: Scanner replaced by one regex generated from the profile; compared with the committed scanner; S1-B and S1-D rerun.
commands: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s1_adapter.py special/LocationScale.html special/Normal.html special/LogNormal.html special/Gamma.html

results.name: corpus_rerun_changes
results.note: numbers unchanged; only earlier committed fixes visible

conclusion: The profile-generated pattern is identical to the scanner; the 78-page rerun changes nothing.
